clues: This city sits on a T-shaped island in a warm gulf, just off the coast of its land. Bridges join the island to the shore.
This city has a hot desert climate, with sunny blue skies near all year. Its summer months turn extremely hot and damp for months on end.
In 1971, this city and five neighbours joined to form one new land. The new land's first president then ruled from this city.
A vast white mosque in this city was built with marble, stone, and gold from lands around the world. Thousands of workers helped to build it.
The government of its land works from this city. The president of the land lives and works here too, in its palaces.
